lines.en: label day91:
scene daynineone1
"With just a few days left until the testing period finally begins, the girls are
lines.zh: 「距离考期终于开始只剩几天了，女孩们都在

lines.en: hard at work and studying diligently."
lines.zh: 埋头苦读、认真复习。」

lines.en: : Sensei! Come look at my sword!
lines.zh: : Sensei！快来看我的刀！

lines.en: : It’s sharp enough to cut three bodies in one strike!
lines.zh: : 它锋利到一刀能砍断三具身体！

lines.en: : I’m sure it is, Ayane. I can see it from here. It’s very nice.
lines.zh: : 我相信是的，Ayane。我在这儿都看得出来。非常棒。

lines.en: : I will use this blade to defend our children.
lines.zh: : 我会用这把刀来守护我们的孩子。

lines.en: : I’m sure you will.
lines.zh: : 我相信你会的。

lines.en: Okay, so maybe not everyone is studying diligently.
lines.zh: 好吧，也许也不是每个人都在认真复习。

lines.en: In fact, only Makoto is. But that’s basically how things are in here now.
lines.zh: 事实上只有 Makoto 在。不过这地方现在基本上就是这个样子了。

lines.en: I’m not too worried, though. I mean, everyone seems confident enough to pass at least most of the subjects.
lines.zh: 不过我不太担心。我是说，大家看起来都挺有信心，至少能通过大部分科目。

lines.en: I’m not sure how grading for these things goes, but I’m sure you don’t have to pass every subject, right?...
lines.zh: 我不太清楚这种考试的评分怎么算，但我想总不至于每科都得及格吧？……

lines.en: Oh well. They’ll be fine. It would be incredibly disruptive to the plot if they weren’t.
lines.zh: 算了。她们会没事的。要是她们出事，那对剧情的破坏可就太大了。

lines.en: scene daynineone2
Sana suddenly raises her hand and I can hear her ellipses from the back of the room.
lines.zh: Sana 突然举起了手，我从教室后排都能听见她的省略号。

lines.en: It’s not like her to command my attention in class...I wonder if something is wrong?
lines.zh: 她平时不会在课上主动吸引我的注意……是不是出了什么事？

lines.en: scene daynineone3
: Hey, Sana. Do you need something?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Sana。有什么事吗？

lines.en: : Um...Not particularly...
lines.zh: : 嗯……也没什么特别的……

lines.en: : You just...seemed bored...so I thought I’d wave you over and...
lines.zh: : 你只是……看起来很无聊……所以我想把你叫过来，然后……

lines.en: : You wanted to see if I wanted to talk, right?
lines.zh: : 你是想看看我想不想聊天，对吧？

lines.en: : R-right...
lines.zh: : 是、是的……

lines.en: : I’m still...not really friends with anyone else and...
lines.zh: : 我还是……没和别人交上朋友，而且……

lines.en: scene daynineone4
: And Ayane has a sword for some reason...
lines.zh: : 还有 Ayane 不知为什么拿着一把刀……

lines.en: : Are you surprised by this?
lines.zh: : 你对此感到惊讶吗？

lines.en: : I think I should be, but...no...
lines.zh: : 我觉得我应该惊讶，可是……并没有……

lines.en: s "Sword aside, don’t you think maybe it might be time to branch out a little and...you know, maybe
lines.zh: s 「先不管刀的事，你不觉得也许是时候稍微拓展一下交际圈了……那个，

lines.en: make some friends?"
lines.zh: 交几个朋友？」

lines.en: scene daynineone5
: W-What?! You mean...like...right now?...
lines.zh: : 什、什么？！你是说……就……现在？……

lines.en: : With everyone watching?...
lines.zh: : 当着所有人的面？……

lines.en: : No one is even looking at you.
lines.zh: : 根本没人看你。

lines.en: scene daynineone6
: What else is new?...
lines.zh: : 这不是常有的事吗？……

lines.en: : Sana...even if people were looking at you, it shouldn’t change anything.
lines.zh: : Sana……就算有人在看你，也不该改变什么。

lines.en: s "The key to becoming social is just learning how to ignore everybody and adapt to conversation
lines.zh: s 「变得善于社交的关键，就是学会无视所有人，然后不经过任何思考

lines.en: without putting any actual thought into it."
lines.zh: 就能接上话。」

lines.en: scene daynineone7
: Please...don’t try to sabotage me, Sensei...I have a hard enough time as is...
lines.zh: : 拜托……别来拆我的台了，Sensei……我已经够难的了……

lines.en: : Well, how about this? I’ll make the first move for you.
lines.zh: : 那么，这样如何？我来替你迈出第一步。

lines.en: scene daynineone5
: Wait...what? First move? What are you going to do?...
lines.zh: : 等等……什么？第一步？你要做什么？……

lines.en: : Something I should have done a long time ago...
lines.zh: : 一件我很久以前就该做的事……

lines.en: scene daynineone6
: I don’t like the sound of this...
lines.zh: : 这话听着不太妙……

lines.en: : It’s okay. Just think about all of our training.
lines.zh: : 没事的。想想我们之前的训练。

lines.en: scene daynineone7
: You’ve...barely even taught me anything...
lines.zh: : 你……根本就没教过我什么啊……

lines.en: scene daynineone8
: Hey, Rin.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Rin。

lines.en: scene daynineone9
: Hm? Sensei? What’s up?
lines.zh: : 嗯？Sensei？怎么啦？

lines.en: : Not much. How are you doing?
lines.zh: : 没什么。你最近怎么样？

lines.en: Sana suddenly begins to tug on my sleeve.
lines.zh: Sana 突然开始拽我的袖子。

lines.en: : Um...S-Sensei...
lines.zh: : 嗯……S……Sensei……

lines.en: scene daynineone10
: Uhh...I mean, I’m pretty good I guess. Just looking outside the window and stuff.
lines.zh: : 呃……我大概挺好的吧。就是看看窗外什么的。

lines.en: s "Awesome. But what if I told you that there were more exciting things to do than
lines.zh: s 「不错嘛。不过要是我告诉你，还有比看窗外更

lines.en: look out of the window?"
lines.zh: 带劲的事呢？」

lines.en: scene daynineone11
: I’d...agree? I just don’t know what else to do instead.
lines.zh: : 我……同意吧？只是我不知道还有什么别的可以干。

lines.en: : Futaba is reading and stuff and she doesn’t like being bothered in the middle of that.
lines.zh: : Futaba 在看书什么的，而且她不喜欢看到一半被打扰。

lines.en: : Uh...umm...
The tugging grows stronger.
lines.zh: 袖子被拽得更用力了。

lines.en: : Well how about you talk to Sana, then?
lines.zh: : 那你要不要跟 Sana 聊聊？

lines.en: scene daynineone12
: I mean, sure. I’d love to.
lines.zh: : 当然可以啊。我很乐意。

lines.en: : She’s just always so quiet that I didn’t think she really wanted to talk to anybody.
lines.zh: : 只是她一直都那么安静，我还以为她其实不想跟谁说话呢。

lines.en: scene daynineone13
: Um...I would...love to talk!
lines.zh: : 嗯……我……很乐意聊！

lines.en: : See? That wasn’t so hard, was it?
lines.zh: : 看吧？也没那么难，对吧？

lines.en: : Just talk to Rin the same way you talk to me and everything will be fine.
lines.zh: : 你就像跟我说话那样跟 Rin 说话，一切就都没问题了。

lines.en: scene daynineone14
: Will you...stay and make sure I do everything right?
lines.zh: : 你能……留下来看着我做对吗？

lines.en: : Nope. Your mission begins now.
lines.zh: : 不行。你的任务现在开始。

lines.en: : Have fun!
lines.zh: : 玩得开心！

lines.en: : What?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！

lines.en: scene daynineone15
: Ah-!
: Cool! Mission text!
lines.zh: : 酷！任务文本！

lines.en: scene daynineone16
: Uh...umm...ahh...
: Hey, Sana! What’s up?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Sana！怎么样啊？

lines.en: : Um...nothing! Wh-What’s...up...with you?
lines.zh: : 嗯……没什么！你、你……怎么样……？

lines.en: : Oh, you know. Just hangin’ around the classroom, doing classroom stuff. Same old, same old.
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的。就在教室里待着，干点教室里的活。老样子啦。

lines.en: : The two of us haven’t really talked before, have we?
lines.zh: : 我们俩以前其实没怎么说过话，对吧？

lines.en: "I stand several steps back and watch as Sana begins her first ever conversation
lines.zh: 「我往后退了几步，看着 Sana 开始了她有生以来的第一次对话——

lines.en: girl who has sat literally right next to her for the entire year."
lines.zh: 对象就是那个一整年都紧挨着她坐的女孩。」

lines.en: In order to get a good look, though, I need to stand right next to Ayane.
lines.zh: 不过为了看得清楚，我得站到 Ayane 旁边。

lines.en: Which of course means I need to continuously swat her hand away from me every three seconds.
lines.zh: 这当然也意味着我每隔三秒就得把她的手从我身上拍开一次。

lines.en: scene daynineone17
: Um...no...we haven’t...
lines.zh: : 嗯……没有……我们没说过……

lines.en: : I’ve always...wanted to, but...
lines.zh: : 我一直……都想，可是……

lines.en: : It’s okay. Take your time.
lines.zh: : 没关系。慢慢来。

lines.en: : I get nervous around new people, too. Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 我在陌生人面前也会紧张。别放在心上。

lines.en: r "Besides, it’s not like I’m going anywhere. We’re still in[school] for another
lines.zh: r 「再说了，我又不会跑掉。我们还要在[school]待上

lines.en: like, three hours or something."
lines.zh: 大概三个小时什么的呢。」

lines.en: scene daynineone18
: R-Right! Th...thanks...
lines.zh: : 是、是的！谢……谢谢……

lines.en: : Of course! So, is there anything you’d like to talk about?
lines.zh: : 当然！那么，你有什么想聊的吗？

lines.en: : You play games and stuff, right?
lines.zh: : 你玩游戏什么的吧？

lines.en: As expected, Rin takes the lead in the conversation and begins to steer Sana back into her comfort zone.
lines.zh: 不出所料，Rin 主导了对话，开始把 Sana 引回她的舒适区。

lines.en: I think back to the other day when I was hanging out with Sara and Haruka.
lines.zh: 我想起前几天跟 Sara 和 Haruka 一起玩的时候。

lines.en: I remember thinking then that it was weird these two had never gotten to know each other.
lines.zh: 我当时就觉得奇怪，这两个人居然从没互相认识过。

lines.en: And, given Sana’s current skill level when it comes to public speaking, Rin is probably a great option for a first non-Ayane friend.
lines.zh: 而考虑到 Sana 目前在当众说话这方面的水平，Rin 大概是她第一个「非 Ayane 朋友」的绝佳人选。

lines.en: scene daynineone19
: Y-Yes! I love games! Do you...um...
lines.zh: : 是、是的！我超爱游戏的！你……嗯……

lines.en: : Do you play anything, Rin?...
lines.zh: : 你有玩什么吗，Rin？……

lines.en: Great job, Sana- already calling her by her name.
lines.zh: 干得漂亮，Sana——已经能直接叫出她的名字了。

lines.en: "It’s a small detail, but a very important one in the world of socialization. Using someone’s
lines.zh: 「这是个很小的细节，但在社交的世界里却非常重要。叫出别人的

lines.en: name helps assure them that you’re paying attention."
lines.zh: 名字，能让对方确信你在认真听。」

lines.en: I’m sure Rin doesn’t care about (Or even notice) things like that, but I’m still proud regardless.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定 Rin 并不在意（甚至根本没注意到）这种事，但我还是照样感到骄傲。

lines.en: : Senseiiiii~
lines.zh: : Sensei~~~~~

lines.en: : Ayane, stop touching me.
lines.zh: : Ayane，别碰我。

lines.en: : Boo...
: Of course!
lines.zh: : 当然啦！

lines.en: scene daynineone20
r "Let’s see...I don’t really have as much time to play stuff as I used to, but I
lines.zh: r 「让我想想……我现在玩的时间没以前那么多了，不过

lines.en: really like online multiplayer stuff mostly."
lines.zh: 我最喜欢的还是线上联机那类。」

lines.en: : So like...MMO’s? Or do you like shooters more?...
lines.zh: : 那比如说……MMO？还是你更喜欢射击游戏？……

lines.en: scene daynineone21
: Shooters. The more they bleed, the stronger I become...
lines.zh: : 射击。他们血流得越多，我就变得越强……

lines.en: scene daynineone22
: H-huh?...
: Is this...what bullying is?...
lines.zh: : 这……就是霸凌吗？……

lines.en: : Are you...trying to intimidate me?...
lines.zh: : 你是……想吓我吗？……

lines.en: scene daynineone23
: What?! No! Of course not! That was just a joke!
lines.zh: : 什么？！不是！当然不是！那只是个玩笑！

lines.en: : I like shooters, yeah, but I don’t actually become stronger by consuming peoples’ blood or anything.
lines.zh: : 我是喜欢射击游戏啦，但我又不会靠喝别人的血变强什么的。

lines.en: : I was just playing around. I’m not bullying you at all.
lines.zh: : 我只是开个玩笑。我绝对不是在霸凌你。

lines.en: r "In fact, I think you’re super cute and like, I’ve kinda wanted to be your
lines.zh: r 「事实上，我觉得你超级可爱，而且……我从开学起就

lines.en: friend since the year started and stuff."
lines.zh: 一直有点想跟你做朋友什么的。」

lines.en: scene daynineone24
: Huh?...You’ve...
lines.zh: : 咦？……你一直……

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : Of course! You’ve just always seemed kinda...distant.
lines.zh: : 当然！只是你看起来总是有点……疏远。

lines.en: r "Oh, and I also want to try on that one dress you wear around the dorm all
lines.zh: r 「哦，还有我也想试试你成天在宿舍里穿的那条裙子，

lines.en: the time, but there’s no way in hell it would ever fit me."
lines.zh: 不过它打死也穿不进我身上。」

lines.en: scene daynineone25
: Um...well...if it’s not a bother...I...
lines.zh: : 嗯……那个……如果不麻烦的话……我……

lines.en: : I wouldn’t mind being your...friend...
lines.zh: : 我不介意当你的……朋友……

lines.en: scene daynineone18
: Really? Awesome! That’s great news!
lines.zh: : 真的吗？太棒了！这真是个好消息！

lines.en: : Maybe the two of us could hang out sometime then!
lines.zh: : 那我们俩改天可以一起玩啊！

lines.en: : You’re literally in the room connected to mine, so it’s not like you don’t know where to find me.
lines.zh: : 你就住在我隔壁那间，所以你不可能不知道去哪儿找我吧。

lines.en: scene daynineone19
: I’d...love to! Thank you so much!
lines.zh: : 我……很愿意！太谢谢你了！

lines.en: : Dude, you don’t have to thank me.
lines.zh: : 老兄，你不用谢我啦。

lines.en: r "Like I said, you’re super cute and I’ve wanted to be your friend
lines.zh: r 「就像我说的，你超级可爱，而且我想跟你做朋友

lines.en: for a while. Just let me know whenever you want to chill, okay?"
lines.zh: 已经想好久了。想来玩的时候随时告诉我就行，好吗？」

lines.en: : Okay! Thank you!
lines.zh: : 好！谢谢你！

lines.en: : Oh, I mean, umm...
lines.zh: : 哦，我是说，嗯……

lines.en: scene daynineone26
: Hey! We did it!
lines.zh: : 嘿！我们做到了！

lines.en: : Where are these letters coming from?...
lines.zh: : 这些字是从哪儿冒出来的？……

lines.en: scene daynineone27
I wait a minute before returning to Sana’s desk to congratulate her on a job well done.
lines.zh: 我等了一会儿，才回到 Sana 的座位旁，祝贺她干得漂亮。

lines.en: : Sensei! Did you...did you see what happened?!
lines.zh: : Sensei！你……你看见刚才发生什么了吗？！

lines.en: : I made a friend!
lines.zh: : 我交到朋友了！

lines.en: "Sana is loud enough that Rin can hear her, but instead of jumping into
lines.zh: 「Sana 的声音大到 Rin 都听得见，但 Rin 没有插进

lines.en: the conversation, she just glances over and winks at me."
lines.zh: 对话，只是朝这边看了一眼，冲我眨了下眼。」

lines.en: : I did. You were great, Sana. Like I’ve been saying, it’s not that hard to-
lines.zh: : 我看见了。你很棒，Sana。就像我一直说的，这没那么难——

lines.en: : No, it was totally hard! I almost cried!
lines.zh: : 不，超级难的！我差点就哭了！

lines.en: : But I didn’t! I pulled through!
lines.zh: : 但我忍住了！我挺过来了！

lines.en: : And now I have a new friend!
lines.zh: : 而且我现在有新朋友了！

lines.en: s "That’s right! Now you just need to befriend the rest of the class and
lines.zh: s 「没错！现在你只要跟班上其他人也交上朋友，

lines.en: your main quest-line will finally be complete."
lines.zh: 你的主线任务线就终于完成了。」

lines.en: scene daynineone28
: Wait...I have to be friends with everyone?...
lines.zh: : 等等……我得跟所有人都交朋友吗？……

lines.en: : That’s right. Keep working hard, Sana.
lines.zh: : 没错。继续努力吧，Sana。

lines.en: : But...I was barely even able to make one...
lines.zh: : 可是……我连一个都才勉强交到……

lines.en: scene black
"I head back to my seat without giving Sana an opportunity to argue why she doesn’t
lines.zh: 「我径直回到自己的座位，没给 Sana 机会去辩解为什么她不需要

lines.en: need to become friends with everyone in class."
lines.zh: 跟班上所有人都成为朋友。」

lines.en: And the fact is, she doesn’t.
lines.zh: 而事实是，她确实不需要。

lines.en: It’s rare that anyone in any class is ever friends with everyone.
lines.zh: 任何一个班里，能和所有人都成为朋友的人都很罕见。

lines.en: But in Sana’s case, I think it’s a good idea.
lines.zh: 但在 Sana 这种情况下，我觉得这是个好主意。

lines.en: Or, at least it’s one of the only ways I can think of getting her to open up more for now...
lines.zh: 或者至少，这是我现在能想到的、让她更放得开的唯一办法之一……

lines.en: Oh well.
lines.zh: 算了。

lines.en: We’ll just have to see how things go from here on out.
lines.zh: 接下来会怎样，只能走一步看一步了。

lines.en: $ sana_love += 1
$ day91 = True
Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]!
lines.zh: Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]！
